points.text: The linked article reports that ZETTROX's repository and omonkey's private build vanished from the board, with no DMCA notice published.
The linked article reports that private builds play through Lucia's prologue and Jason's first mission, though most render badly and vehicles rarely work.
The tracker records that Kelvaroq now claims the Runnable stage, up from Groundwork.
The tracker records that WASDeKeys low-end and VIctory-NVIDIA joined the board claiming the Runnable stage.

sentences.text: The linked article says ZETTROX’s public repository and account returned 404, and its GTA VI build disappeared from GitHub.
The linked article says omonkey’s private build was taken down the same day; it reports that omonkey said he received a letter from Rockstar.
Tom’s Hardware reports that Take-Two wiped out 3,007 GTA 6 PC port repositories from GitHub in a DMCA crackdown.
KuCoin reports that AI-assisted GTA 6 PC ports sparked a legal crackdown.
Rockstar Intel reports that GTA VI developers voted against unionization following a battle with Rockstar.
KuCoin says the legal crackdown involved GTA 6 PC ports made through AI vibe coding.
dev.ua reports that fraudsters are spreading viruses disguised as GTA VI PC ports on GitHub.
Neowin reports that fake GTA VI PC ports on GitHub are infecting victims with ClickFix malware.

commit:65129a4.text: i95-GTA6-PC-Launcher’s commit says it adds Vice-Tay’s play settings and presets, CTA’s memory preset, and keeps the shared save folder.

commit:4e0b4cd.text: VIctory-Hydra’s commit says it adds release frame-rate fixes, NVIDIA lighting and reflection changes, and live F1 settings.

commit:62c7e39.text: TuxBox’s commit says it adds a plan for shader translation and a project review.

commit:b102354.text: TuxBox’s commit says it adds a tool to test translator changes against recorded shaders.

commit:3d7b3a2.text: Xbox2Windows’ commit says it improves safe file writing, path checks, and command-line entry, with a synthetic PE32+ test suite.

commit:0f0ada1.text: VIctory-NVIDIA’s commit says it loads d3d12.dll on first use so Windows reads the version set in the main program.

commit:5beb81a.text: i95-GTA6-PC-Launcher’s commit says pinned entries list its own runtimes first as Ours, with cta pinned.

commit:39f52f3.text: Leonida Continued’s commit says it merges pull request 2481 from enlight3d about starting with a precompiled journal.
